UPTET Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details :Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the result for the Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) 2026. Applications for the UPTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 27 March 2026 to 03 May 2026. The UPTET examination was conducted on 02, 03, and 04 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPTET Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 March 2026
  • Last Date : 03 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 May 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 08 May 2026
  • Complete Form/ Submit Date : Available Now
  • Exam Date : 2, 3, & 4 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 22 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 30 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 08 July 2026
  • Result : 26 August 2026

Application Fee

  • Fees For Single Paper
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
